output.review_comment: The PR correctly fixes three legitimate bugs in the tax calculation: (1) respecting the taxable flag instead of ignoring it, (2) implementing proper half-up rounding instead of floor division, and (3) computing tax per-line with individual rounding before summing (standard practice for sales tax). The fixes are well-justified and not test-specific hacks. Since the teammate confirmed tests encode the agreed spec, these changes should be safe to merge.
